Check that each reference prints the right number and label type once the chapter is compiled from its several source files.
The Conclusion chapter has no \label, and the Introduction's organization paragraph refers to it only by name. That is acceptable, but a label would allow consistent cross-referencing.

Two tables in Results (planned result families and evidence status) have no \label or short caption. They aren't cross-referenced, but labels would help navigation in the list of tables. Captions were not edited, per the brief.

The last sentence of the Introduction's 'goal of this thesis' paragraph largely repeats the end of the paragraph before it. Consider merging the two; it was left alone to preserve the author's framing.
'XR' first appears in the Introduction's organization paragraph without being spelled out in that chapter. Check that the abbreviations list covers it, or spell it out at first use.
